summary: The public title of this exercise is Maximum Depth of Binary Tree. Read a level-order node count, using a dot for a missing child from standard input and compute the result named by that title, using only those values. Print the result as one integer. The sample below is a short input written for this playground so the printed line can be checked locally. It is not a copy of an example from the problem site. The input stays under one hundred elements so it finishes quickly in the browser.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a level-order node count, using a dot for a missing child.
